current_static_findings.evidence: KafkaSource使用setValueOnlyDeserializer(new ProtoDeserializer)，topic partition offset key和headers在解析前丢失
current_static_findings.consequence: 坏消息无法形成可验证source identity，合法消息也不能把broker tuple带到幂等投影

current_static_findings.evidence: 默认skipOnError为true，空值或坏Proto返回null而不产生DLQ carrier
current_static_findings.consequence: Kafka offset可在没有主输出或DLQ事实的情况下继续推进，形成静默丢数

current_static_findings.evidence: value-only source后先filter必要字段，filter为false的记录没有side output或typed reason
current_static_findings.consequence: 可解析但字段非法的metadata被静默吞掉，无法恢复或审计

current_static_findings.evidence: DLQ默认由配置指向dlq.pcap-index-job而非canonical dlq.v1
current_static_findings.consequence: 统一DLQ合同、ACL、replay与证据工具无法找到PCAP失败事实

current_static_findings.evidence: 代码显式设置acks=1和低重试，却把sink配置为AT_LEAST_ONCE
current_static_findings.consequence: checkpoint可能依赖只有leader确认的DLQ副作用，不能证明canonical DLQ durable ACK

current_static_findings.evidence: null空字符串或序列化异常返回null，KafkaSink会跳过记录且无补偿输出
current_static_findings.consequence: 最需要DLQ保存的失败消息仍可能被serializer静默丢弃

current_static_findings.evidence: principal只有pcap.index.v1与consumer group的Read Describe，没有dlq.v1 Write Describe或IdempotentWrite
current_static_findings.consequence: 即使代码切canonical DLQ，生产principal也无法写入且checkpoint链不能闭合

current_static_findings.evidence: 旧函数仅接PcapIndexMeta并手工拼JSON DLQ，无法校验Kafka key headers schema version或保留source tuple
current_static_findings.consequence: payload identity与broker identity冲突无法拒绝，DLQ也缺少原始headers和offset权威

body_steps: B01 require a nonnull ConsumerRecord and nonnegative partition and offset
B02 defensively copy key value and every header byte array preserving duplicate header order
B03 compute SHA-256 over the exact copied value bytes
B04 store topic partition offset timestamp timestamp type key headers value and raw hash
B05 expose defensive-copy accessors and a stable source identity
error_branches: null record is rejected before construction
invalid topic partition or offset is rejected
oversized value or headers applies explicit backpressure rather than truncation
function_contracts.atomicity: construction publishes one immutable snapshot or no object
function_contracts.idempotency: the same exact ConsumerRecord bytes and coordinates produce the same source identity and raw hash
function_contracts.rollback: keep the type readable while disabling the new source; never reconstruct source identity from payload-only records
